note: dev concepts only; descriptive; answers §16.1 Q1-Q9 by their pre-registered rules

Q1.rule: median dR1p above the rand-dir 95th pct at >= 3 strengths for condition 1 and condition 2

Q2.rule: word prefill: mean R2 at the best strength for condition 1 or 2 >= 0.25

Q3.rule: B unless B2's condition-2 dR1p exceeds B's by >= 1 nat without a larger B1

Q6.rule: c-clamp lowers u_perp's report more than the random clamp (bootstrap CI over concepts excludes 0)

Q7.rule: c in J_NP top-10 on pure u_perp at >= 2 layers of the band (§16.1 Q7)

token_probe_note: probe_det: above the strongest of 5 random directions at the same dose (pre-registered; scale-free in a deterministic forward, so it fires at any dose); probe_abs: the probe classifies the read as the concept (decision > 0), a post-hoc absolute criterion

Q10.rule: c-clamp lowers u_perp's dR1p more than its random-clamp null at u_perp's best strength (bootstrap CI over evaluable dev concepts excludes 0)

Q11.rule: under u_perp at strengths above the null, median J_NP rank of c at C_o <= 10 at some layer L32-62 and below the rand-dir 5th-percentile rank there

Q12.rule: first layer where >= 50% of dev concepts are probe-detected at C_o above the max of 5 rand-dir seeds
